summary_rationale: Astra Microwave possesses genuine, hard-to-replicate RF/microwave qualification moats (30 MHz–40 GHz, in-house 17m NFTR and NABL EMI/EMC chambers, ISRO space-grade certification, and the 50:50 Astra Rafael Comsys JV) that have propelled consolidated backlog to ₹4,708 Cr in Q2 FY27 (99.2% domestic defence in standalone) and expanded OPM from 12% in FY22 to 29% in FY26 (33% in Q2 FY27) with ROCE at 20.3%. However, the business is structurally cyclical and working-capital intensive rather than an unconditional compounder: it endured a 53% revenue drawdown in FY15–FY19, carries a 537-day cash conversion cycle (216 debtor days, 394 inventory days), generated negative cumulative 12-year Free Cash Flow (-₹46 Cr across FY15–FY26 despite ₹897 Cr cumulative PAT) prior to FY26's +₹304 Cr FCF release, exhibits heavy Q4 revenue bunching (42% in Mar quarter), and operates with a low 6.54% promoter stake alongside periodic equity dilution (FY24 equity raise and May 2025 ₹173.99 Cr warrants).
